description: F-1.5.3 sim-realism distance reduction: one bar per synthetic-pipeline variant, height = the aggregate KS distance between that variant's egm-features distribution and the IAFDB reference. The baseline bar is the un-intervened synthetic; each other bar's delta reads out whether that knob moved the synthetic distribution toward real. Until the Phase-1.5 intervention banks exist, the variants are knobs we can already turn (IAFDB-noise on/off, density range) to prove the distance->bar pipeline. inputs.reference names the comparison reference; layout.baseline names the delta reference; styling.metric is 'ks' (unitless) or 'wasserstein'; layout.features optionally restricts which egm-features columns define the distance (default: all). Renders via the 'bar-chart-with-deltas' recipe.
